With such a short lap, track position is paramount. Gaining places at the start is vital for a strong result.
Fuel consumption will be less of a concern on this 1.1km layout, allowing drivers to push harder for longer.

Aggression is rewarded on this track, but drivers need to be mindful of contact and potential penalties.
